review_procedure: Compare each frozen contradiction with accepted ADRs, machine-readable models, current implementation, and explicit limitations.
expected_result: Every contradiction has one non-blocking, evidence-bounded disposition and no semantic blocker remains.

resolutions.implementation_gap: Current SQLite status strings remain a local approximation.
The managed consumer resolver and pointer store are not implemented.
The target lifecycle is not yet enforced by a managed registry.
Managed retention and retirement enforcement are absent.
Runtime sealing and manifest enforcement remain future work.
No Iceberg receipt resolver or external checkpoint reconciler exists.
PostgreSQL/DMS mapping to the transport-neutral frontier requires managed proof.
Reader pinning and table-map resolution are design only.
The local engine exposes only a generic compare-and-swap primitive.
The Terraform topology remains intentionally partial.
The future orchestrator is explicitly unimplemented and unclaimed.
The local proof gate is narrower than the accepted target aggregator.
Architecture claims remain DESIGN_ONLY; runtime and managed claims are not promoted.

limitations: This review resolves semantics; it does not implement or operate the managed design.
External source and transport assumptions remain subject to managed verification.
